items.title: Heap 0
items.summary:
Are overflows only possible on the stack? Explore how data behaves on the heap.
TL;DR Heap 0 is an introductory heap exploitation challenge from picoCTF 2024. The program allocates two adjacent chunks on the heap: input_data and safe_var. Reading user input via an unbounded scanf("%s", input_data) allows an attacker to overflow past the allocated 5-byte chunk boundary, corrupting the subsequent safe_var chunk and fulfilling the win condition strcmp(safe_var, "bico") != 0.
